name: arith_fermat_prime_factor_mod_two_pow_add_two
informal: Lucas' strengthening: for n ≥ 2 every prime factor of the Fermat number F_n is ≡ 1 mod 2^(n+2) — Uses Mathlib2.nt2_fermat_number_prime_factor_form at step 1 to get p ≡ 1 mod 2^(n+1), hence p ≡ 1 mod 8, so 2 is a quadratic residue mod p (ZMod.exists_sq_eq_two_iff); a square root of 2 then has order 2^(n+2), which divides p - 1.
